verses.fasma-khisalan-dhamimatin-muqabbahatan-c: fāsmaʿ khiṣālā dhamīmāti muqabbaḥaha mustaʿmila sh-shammi yā dhā llāhwi wallaʿibi
khaṣlahu kalbi wadhiʾibi wazaghi ʾasadi kadhāka qirdu lishammāmi bilā kadhibi
wafī shamāʾilihi maynu lisāʾilihi bughḍu limāniʿihi walaw ʿalā r-rutabi
yā man yuḥḥaliluhu hal dhāka shīmatu man lidīnihi yuqtadā bal kullu dhāka ʾubī
wamā bihi wuṣlahu tahdī limumtaniʿi fadhāka yulqā bilā shakki walā raybi
